newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish consumer confidence up in November - survey.
newsitem.headline: Polish consumer confidence up in November - survey.

text.p: Polish consumer confidence indicators, measured by the Demoskop polling institute for the Rzeczpospolita daily, rose in November after falling in October, Demoskop said on Tuesday.
Demoskop's consumer confidence index was at 101 points in November after falling to 96 points in October.
The business climate index rose to 99 points in November from 96 in October and the index measuring propensity to spend also rose to 102 points from 95 points.
The Demoskop survey was carried out between November 8 - 12 among a representative random sample of 990 adult Poles.
